eps.o: A loving couple take in a troubled foster child and quickly becomes entwined in a twisted plot that ends in a brutal murder.

Daniel Bible had already lived through - and escaped from - hell. He was doing his best to forget the devil he'd lived with for 8 years - his father. However, to this day, he doesn't know the scope of his father's horrendous crimes.

Domeneka believes she's found real love with her boyfriend, Michael. After having a daughter together, he reveals his violent side. Domeneka fears there's no keeping him from following through on his threats and that she'll be his next target.

eps.t: He's One Hundred Percent a Monster
eps.o: Trina always had a tough childhood but it becomes a nightmare when her mother brings home her new boyfriend, Robert. He is not only controlling, but also cruel and violent. While she knew he was evil, years later she discovers that he is a killer.

A recently divorced woman meets a kind, caring, and nurturing father. Despite her reservations against getting into a new relationship, she falls in love. However, she doesn't see what everyone else around her sees - that he is a killer.

Myrle Miller appears to be a sweet, loving grandmother, but beneath the facade lurks a woman driven by selfishness and greed. Even her own daughter, Rebecca, is haunted by the fact that her mom was a black widow in disguise.
A young mother finally escapes her violent husband, unaware he'll soon be arrested after a deadly killing spree targeting elderly women.

When Felisha meets Wesley, she is a single mum with no place to live; he gives her a home. After they are married and have kids, she discovers he is selfish and unkind. When she finally leaves him, he exacts the cruelest revenge.

eps.t: He Put Me in the Dog Cage
eps.o: As Christy Foe copes with multiple family tragedies, her childhood crush, Joel Lauper, comes to the rescue. However, his arrival is no blessing and she finds herself fighting for her life and confronting evil to not only save herself, but others as well.

Tony believes his mother found happiness with Deputy Dave Rogers, until he sees the dark truth - a man who uses his badge to terrorise and abuse. When two women are found dead, the illusion shatters, revealing a corrupt cop capable of unimaginable evil.
